ayahs.translation: And what could make thee conceive what that sudden calamity will be?
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

ayahs.translation: [It will occur] on the Day when men will be like moths swarming in confusion,
ayahs.transliteration: Yauma ya koonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth
ayahs.sahih: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,

ayahs.translation: and the mountains will be like fluffy tufts of wool....
ayahs.transliteration: Wa ta koonul jibalu kal 'ihnil manfoosh
ayahs.sahih: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.

ayahs.translation: And then, he whose weight [of good deeds] is heavy in the balance
ayahs.sahih: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],

ayahs.translation: shall find himself in a happy' state of life;
ayahs.sahih: He will be in a pleasant life.

ayahs.translation: whereas he whose weight is light in the balance
ayahs.transliteration: Wa amma man khaffat mawa zeenuh
ayahs.sahih: But as for one whose scales are light,

ayahs.translation: shall be engulfed by an abyss.
ayahs.sahih: His refuge will be an abyss.

ayahs.translation: And what could make thee conceive what that [abyss] will be?
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what that is?
It is a Fire, intensely hot.
